summary: The filing reports the results of Qfin Holdings' 2026 annual general meeting. The sole submitted ordinary resolution—to reappoint Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu and Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Certified Public Accountants LLP as auditors for the coming year—was duly adopted. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews. This is a routine governance update by a foreign private issuer on Form 6-K, equivalent to a domestic issuer's Form 8-K reporting annual meeting results. No action or risk-arb angle is warranted.
